usage: A common noun for the saxophone; it is a countable instrument word in everyday speech.
Use it with measure words like 一支 or 呢支 when you refer to one saxophone.
It sounds natural in both music lessons and casual talk; not overly formal.
Common collocations include 吹色士風, 學色士風, and 色士風演奏.
